sam: Quick follow-up after RFC merge — predictive quota shaping prototype is in main. Need migration plan and safety checklist for rollout. Highlights: model predicts 1m token/sec bursts, suggests dynamic lease sizing. Thoughts?

maria: Nice. Biggest worry is exploitability. How do predictions handle synthetic burst traffic? We need conservative caps.

josh: Agree. Add 'hard cap' layer in admission service that overrides prediction. Also require monotonic smoothing window.

ashley: We should run canary per-tenant with opt-in flag. Metric: increase in tail latency <5% and no increase in abuse score.

infra-bot: deploy-pipeline: predictive-shape-proto deployed to staging at 2026-02-10T15:12Z :rocket:

sam: Proposed rollout plan: phase1 internal tenants only (7 days), phase2 opt-in external (2 weeks), phase3 gradual default (4 weeks). Rollback triggers: abuse_score +20% or 99p latency +15%.

maria: Also add TTL-based cooldown when prediction confidence drops. If confidence <0.6, fallback to median historical.

josh: Example policy snippet: ```json
{"policy":"predictive_shaping","window_s":60,"confidence_thresh":0.6,"hard_cap_tokens_per_sec":500000}
```

ashley: Who owns telemetry alerts? ops oncall? We should put alerts in Redwood console and notify #eng-oncall with runbook link.

sam: I'll add alert thresholds to console and wire to paging. Runbook stub: https://go/runbooks/predictive-shape-rollback

maria: Add synthetic adversarial tests in perf lab: ramp patterns + short spikes + polyglot clients. Verify no token leakage.

josh: One more: coordinate with billing team — dynamic shaping may change token accounting. Add a cost-smoothing flag to keep customer bills stable.

ashley: Ack. I'll ping billing and BU leads tomorrow. Also recommend 1-week dark canary where shaping runs but decisions not enforced, only logs.

sam: Love dark canary idea. Action items: ashley ping billing + opt-ins, josh add hard-cap layer + config, maria adversarial testcases, sam add alerts/runbook + canary plan. I'll open follow-up issues.
